investigation: Find the sign-in widget interface assignment and identify the concrete implementation of its virtual +0x48 call.

findings.name: Widget vtable methods
findings.evidence: Virtual +0x308 at 0x144dcd020 binds the widget controls and text callbacks, including HandleTextCommitted and UpdateSignInButton; it does not assign the interface. Decompilation of the listed overrides did not establish acquisition.

findings.name: Nearby field access scan
findings.evidence: Read-only Ghidra instruction scan for displacement 0x410 within 0x80000 bytes either side of 0x144de3880 reported 51 apparent stores, including calls classified as stores. Only the known widget constructor 0x144da86a0 was identified as a widget-specific store; other writes cannot be assigned to this widget solely from the shared displacement. A second all-access scan within 0x40000 bytes reported 43 accesses. LEAs at 0x144dba6f0, 0x144dba9b0, 0x144dbaed0 and 0x144dbcae0 are accesses to a different hash-container layout, and the widget destructor LEA at 0x144dadf31 releases the field.

findings.name: False setter candidate
findings.evidence: Writes object+0x410 under a condition, but reflected wrapper 0x1453064d0 identifies UFortTouchControlRegion::UpdateLockOnStickOrigin. It is not evidence of a sign-in interface assignment.

findings.name: Call-site validity requirement
findings.evidence: After text extraction, the code checks dword widget+0x418, selects widget+0x410 if nonzero or null otherwise, and unconditionally dispatches virtual +0x48 on the selected pointer. No guard returns early for a missing interface; a valid assigned interface is required for this path.

unresolved: The setter/acquisition and concrete slot +0x48 implementation remain unidentified. The bounded displacement scan does not exclude writes through another offset, generic copying or initialization code, or code outside the scanned range. Dynamic observation of a constructed sign-in widget and the value at +0x410/+0x418, or a wider typed data-flow investigation, is required to connect the dispatch to its concrete implementation. Do not infer login completion, broadcast or frontend travel from this scan.
verification: Read-only Ghidra decompilation and runtime image vtable inspection. No build or runtime login test. Ghidra program was not saved; project bookkeeping changed during probes.
superseded_interpretation: The earlier object-interface interpretation was corrected by ../signin_interface_type_runtime/evidence.json: widget+0x410/+0x418 are native delegate allocation/size, and parent construction binds method 0x144e41760. The unsuccessful narrow scans below are retained as investigation history, not current evidence that the binding is unknown.
